newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Ericsson Q1 profit seen up 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ericsson Q1 profit seen up 28 pct.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson was expected to post a higher pre-tax profit of 1.99 billion crowns for the first three months of 1997, according to a Reuters poll of 19 analysts on Wednesday.
Forecasts varied between 1.83 and 2.36 billion crowns.
Ericsson reported a pre-tax profit of 1.55 billion crowns for the corresponding period a year ago which would mean a 28 percent rise in the first quarter this year.
For the full year 1997 the average of the analysts' forecasts earmarked a profit of 12.99 billion crowns.
This forecast was six percent or 720 million crowns higher than a forecast three months ago.
Ericsson will release its report for the first quarter of 1997 on April 25.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Aros, BZW, Carnegie, CSFB, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda, Fischer, Foreningsbanken, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC James Capel, Matteus, Merrill Lynch, Paribas, Penser, SBC Warburg, Schroeders, and Swedbank.
